surface_verification.justification: Backend-affects-frontend: the diff changes a WS envelope contract in both directions, so surface=web is mandatory. Ran the terminal E2E family in real Chromium against an isolated single-process stack (built client + SHIPWRIGHT_STATIC_DIR + temp USERPROFILE, 127.0.0.1:3849). 11 passed. Spec 97 was verified LOAD-BEARING by disabling the server resync dispatch and observing snapshotsAfterResync=0, then restored byte-identically. The one failure (v0-9-5 AC-4) was attributed to pre-existing behaviour by re-running it with the preamble disabled — identical failure — not accepted on assumption.
